unit.why: An excerpt from a letter (אגרת הקודש) describing in general terms the habitual daily and nightly conduct of the tzaddikim (midnight lament, study, seclusion, devekut, wonder-working prayer); it praises them but narrates no single event happening to anyone.
unit.boundary_note: Opens the anthology's section ג on the greatness of tzaddikim; next division is a separate homiletic excerpt (אור לשמים).
